summary: Thomson Reuters filed a Form 6-K announcing court approval for a plan of arrangement to implement a return of capital and share consolidation. The special cash distribution totals US$605 million (approx. US$1.36/share), paired with a proportional reverse stock split. Shareholder approval was obtained at an April 28, 2026 special meeting. The plan is subject to final TSX and Nasdaq approval; effective date targeted for May 4, 2026. Opt-out provisions allow eligible shareholders to avoid the distribution and instead increase proportionate equity via share exchange. The company’s depositary is Computershare. Watch for final regulatory nods and trading under new CUSIP post-consolidation. No risk-arb angle given it is a capital return, not a merger.
